$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2x\,⟹\,\text{d}u=2x\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{2x}{(x^{2}+7)^{2}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{(x^{2}+7)^{2}}\cdot 2x\,\text{d}x \\ & =\int \frac{1}{u^{2}}\,\text{d}u \\ & =-\frac{1}{u}+C \\ & =-\frac{1}{x^{2}+7}+C\end{aligned}
$$
